claims.claim_summary: Unused details recede naturally without explicit importance scores or decay rules.
claims.claim_text_verbatim: Experience that remains unused continues to recede in detail through recursive consolidation, without separately assigned importance scores or time-based forgetting rules.

evidence_spans.source_text: The prominence and specificity of retained knowledge therefore evolve through use and disuse, rather than relying on separately assigned importance scores or time-based forgetting rules.
